title: concierge.yaml

additionalRepos.description: Standing sibling repos cloned on every run of this write repo. One hop only; yaml on a yaml-added repo is ignored.

access.description: write: clone and allow PRs; read: clone for context only

archReview.description: Per-repo tuning of the scheduled architecture review.

largeFiles.description: Opt in to the arch-review large-file check. Presence of the block enables it. Scope is the files the arch review already covers (changed in the churn window, after its lockfile/snapshot/generated filtering); binary files are skipped. Findings use dimension `complexity`, smell `large-file`, and share the complexity quota with high-cyclomatic findings.

enabled.description: Whether the large-file check runs. Default true when the `largeFiles` block is present; set false to switch it off without deleting the block.

threshold.description: Line count above which a file is flagged (strictly greater than). Default 500. Severity is low above 1x, medium above 2x, and high above 3x the threshold.

splitLayout.description: How the suggested fix lays out the split. `subfolder` (default): `src/foo.ts` becomes `src/foo/<concern>.ts` with `src/foo/index.ts` re-exporting the public API (JS/TS). `same-folder`: sibling modules like `src/foo-<concern>.ts`, with `src/foo.ts` kept as a thin facade.

ignore.description: Extra glob patterns excluded from the check, added on top of the built-in defaults (node_modules, vendor, dist, build, coverage, generated/minified files, lock files, snapshots, protobuf output, *.svg, *.csv, *.json, CHANGELOG.md). Minimatch syntax: `**` crosses directories, `*` stays within one segment, dotfiles are matched.

prReview.description: Per-repo control over when the automatic PR review runs.

defaultBranchOnly.description: When true, the automatic PR review only runs on pull requests whose base branch is the repo's default branch (plus any `additionalBaseBranches`). PRs into other branches (stacked or feature-branch PRs) are skipped; the PR Review checkbox still runs a review on demand. Default false — every base branch is reviewed.

additionalBaseBranches.description: Extra base branches still auto-reviewed when `defaultBranchOnly` is true, e.g. `release/*`. `*` matches any run of characters, including `/`. Ignored when `defaultBranchOnly` is false.

reviewGate.description: Per-repo tuning of the review gate.

autoApprove.description: Opt in to Concierge auto-approve. When true and the repo has the review gate enabled, Concierge submits an informational APPROVE review on eligible PRs. Overridden by teams.json's reviewGateAutoApprove when a team or repo sets one.

autoApproveRiskCeiling.description: Highest repo risk Concierge may auto-approve in. A repo above it always needs a human. It never raises the combined-risk threshold. Omit for no ceiling. Overridden by teams.json's reviewGateAutoApproveRiskCeiling when a team or repo sets one.

excludeCommitAuthors.description: Whether an approver who authored a commit on the PR head is excluded from counting as an independent approver. Default true. Set false to disable this exclusion for the repo. Overridden by teams.json's reviewGateExcludeCommitAuthors when a team or repo sets one.

requireIndependentReviewer.description: Whether a Concierge-requested PR requires approval from someone other than the requestor (separation of duties). Default true. Set false to let the requestor's own approval satisfy the gate. Overridden by teams.json's reviewGateRequireIndependentReviewer when a team or repo sets one.

pathRisk.description: Risk level per path, as glob patterns (`**` crosses directories, `*` stays within one segment). Keys: critical, high, medium, low. When several patterns match a file, the most specific pattern wins; on a specificity tie, the highest risk wins. critical/high matches block auto-approve; low matches exempt the file from the production-files veto; medium and unmatched files keep default behaviour. Not overridable from teams.json.

critical.description: Glob patterns whose matching files are critical risk

high.description: Glob patterns whose matching files are high risk

medium.description: Glob patterns whose matching files are medium risk

low.description: Glob patterns whose matching files are low risk

skills.description: Externally-sourced Claude skills staged on every workflow run of this repo. Each entry is a cultureamp repo (owner/repo); omit `path` for whole-repo discovery (every SKILL.md dir), or set `path` to a single skill's SKILL.md directory. `ref` is reserved — v1 always uses the default branch and records its resolved SHA.

description: Repo-owned standing sibling contract for Concierge
